newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB awarded Malaysia bank licence.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB awarded Malaysia bank licence.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB), the nation's most profitable bank, said on Monday it had been granted an international offshore banking licence in Malaysia.
"It is the first offshore banking licence to be granted by the Malaysian government to an Australian bank," NAB said in a statement.
The licence had been granted in the Federal Territory of Labuan and a marketing office would be established in Kuala Lumpur to support the Labuan branch, NAB said.
An interntional offshore financial centre was established in Labuan by the Malaysian government in 1990 to develop the country's financial services sector.
NAB would use its licence to offer foreign currency lending and deposits, foreign exchange and other treasury services, it said.
NAB won similar licence approvals in Thailand and Taiwan in December last year.
